ModuleName: 7 - Drawing and Graphics with the HTML5 Canvas

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Outlines the full scope of the module by listing its major topics and subtopics—covering the HTML5 Canvas element, drawing shapes, paths and lines, colors and styles, text, images, and animations—serving as a navigational overview for learners and a planning reference for instructors.

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics (HTML)
Artifacts.Description: An overview page listing the module's core topics—introducing the HTML5 Canvas element, adding it to a webpage, and accessing the 2D rendering context with JavaScript—which learners use to preview what they will study and instructors use to communicate the module's scope.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to the HTML5 Canvas Element
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains what the HTML5 Canvas element is, its history and advantages over older plugin-based approaches, and how to add it to a webpage and obtain a 2D rendering context in JavaScript, serving as the foundational lesson before any drawing begins.

Artifacts.Name: Drawing Basic Shapes
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers how to prepare the canvas context and draw basic shapes such as rectangles and other primitives using the Canvas 2D API, teaching learners the essential first steps for rendering graphics programmatically.

Artifacts.Name: Working with Paths and Lines
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains the Canvas path system — including beginPath(), moveTo(), lineTo(), stroke(), arc(), and curves — showing learners how to define and render complex shapes and line-based drawings step by step.

Artifacts.Name: Applying Colors, Styles, and Gradients
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers how to apply fill and stroke colors, transparency, linear and radial gradients, and blending options in the Canvas 2D API, teaching learners how to control the visual appearance of all drawn elements.

Artifacts.Name: Rendering Text on the Canvas
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to render and style text directly on an HTML5 Canvas using the Canvas 2D API, covering font properties, fillText(), strokeText(), and text measurement, and distinguishing canvas text from DOM-based text.

Artifacts.Name: Drawing and Manipulating Images
Artifacts.Description: A reading that covers how to draw, scale, crop, and manipulate raster images on the HTML5 Canvas using drawImage() and related API features, providing the skills needed for use cases such as photo editors, sprite-based games, and image overlays.

Artifacts.Name: Foundations of Interactive Canvas Graphics
Artifacts.Description: A reading that explains how to combine the Canvas drawing surface with the browser's event system to create interactive graphics, covering event listeners, coordinate mapping, and real-time user input handling on the canvas.

Artifacts.Name: Foundations of Interactive Canvas Graphics
Artifacts.Description: A duplicate reading of the Foundations of Interactive Canvas Graphics lesson covering how to wire browser events to canvas drawing for real-time interactive graphics, which learners and instructors can use identically to artifact 8.
